column1: on the day preceding the date of commencement of this Act

column2: The moneys and property of the Corporation however

column1: derived shall be applied solely towards the promotion of its

bonus, profit or otherwise howsoever to the members of the
Corporation.

column2: Subject to the provisions of this Act, the Corporation

column1: shall  be  able  and  capable  in  law  to  acquire  and  hold  any
